subject: Invoice intake decision: webfront vs email fallback + onboarding fields
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: accounts-payable@holloway.ai
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Invoice intake decision: webfront vs email fallback + onboarding fields

Hi Lisa / AP team,

Thanks for starting the vendor activation process. Before we book the onboarding call, a couple quick questions so we can wire your account correctly:

1) Channel preference (short-term vs long-term)
   - Short-term: send invoices via email to ap-invoices@redwood-invoice.com (we use subject tokens for automatic routing).
   - Long-term: enroll in our supplier webfront (portal) where you can upload CSV/PDF and see ACKs.

2) PO handling
   - Do you normally send invoices that reference a Redwood PO per line, or a single PO at the header level? If header-level, do you expect us to match line items?

3) Required fields we need on each invoice/CSV row: PO_NUMBER, INVOICE_NUMBER, INVOICE_DATE (YYYY-MM-DD), LINE_DESCRIPTION, QTY, UNIT_PRICE, TAX_AMOUNT, BILL_TO_ENTITY.

4) File naming and subject token
   - If emailing, include subject token: [RW-ACCT-####] and filename convention: HOLLOWAY_INV_<PO>_<INV>.csv

Attached: supplier_onboarding_form.pdf (fill + sign), redwood_onboard_template.docx (sample field mapping), sample_invoice.csv (one exemplar).

If you prefer portal enrollment I can send a one-click invite and a short admin guide. Otherwise, we can enable email fallback with subject tokens and a 24–48h ACK SLA.

Can you reply with channel preference and confirm whether your invoices are header-PO or line-PO? If helpful, Monica can join the onboarding call to walk through CSV mapping.

Thanks,

Kimberly Park
Vendor Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks — quick answers from Holloway side:

- Short-term we'd prefer email fallback. Our AP team workflows are still on Coupa and we can push a feed later.
- Invoices are typically header-level PO references (one PO per invoice), but some exceptions exist (multiple POs on a single invoice).
- ACK timing: 24–48h is fine. Can you confirm if we get an automated acceptance/exception email with line-level match status?
- Security: can you accept SFTP or TLS-encrypted SMTP? Right now our outgoing mail uses enforced TLS to partners.

Attached a vendor profile (holloway_profile.xlsx) with contact names and sample invoice.

If portal enrollment is strongly recommended for reconciliation, we'll plan for it, but we'd like to start via email while we tidy our ERP exports.

Best,
Lisa Grant
Director, Finance Ops
Holloway AI
lisa.grant@holloway.ai

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Grant <lisa.grant@holloway.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 08:43:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Invoice intake decision: webfront vs email fallback + onboarding fields

Hi Lisa — thanks for the quick reply and the profile sheet. A few clarifications and next steps from ops: 

- Email ingestion / matching behavior
  * If you choose email fallback, include the subject token in the email subject (we'll provision a unique token for Holloway). The parser will extract attached CSVs and PDFs.
  * For header-level POs we will attempt a header match first; if your invoice has multiple PO lines in one file we will try line-level matching and return a match report. Exceptions generate an automated ticket to your AP contact.

- CSV schema specifics (please align column headers exactly):
  * PO_NUMBER, INVOICE_NUMBER, INVOICE_DATE (YYYY-MM-DD), BILL_TO_ENTITY, SHIP_TO_ENTITY, LINE_NUMBER, DESCRIPTION, QUANTITY, UNIT_PRICE, TAX, CURRENCY
  * If you do header-only invoices, leave LINE_NUMBER blank and include a single line per invoice with aggregated amounts and a DESCRIPTION like "Header total".

- Security options
  * We support TLS-encrypted SMTP (STARTTLS enforced). SFTP is an option for high-volume partners — let us know if you want SFTP credentials.

- ACKs and matching report
  * Within 24h you get an automatic ACK for receipt; matching/result report (including unmatched lines and PO mismatches) is sent within 48h. If you want immediate real-time feedback, portal uploads show status instantly.

Next steps:
  1) Kimberly will provision a subject token and confirm ap-invoices@ entry.
  2) Fill and return the supplier_onboarding_form.pdf (DocuSign link below) so we can set your billing entity and tax info.
  3) If you want a portal invite, reply and we'll queue that for you — otherwise we'll enable email ingestion and send the token.

DocuSign (fill): https://docusign.com/drive/ABC12345
Onboarding call: https://calendly.com/kimberly-park/redwood-onboard-30m

I'll set up a quick intake test once we have the token and a sample invoice file.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Supplier Enablement 
Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com
